a: Edward McKendree Bounds (1835–1913) yali musumba Omumesodisiti Omunnamerika, omusumba w'abaserikale mu Lutalo lw'Omunda mu Amerika, era eyali munnamateeka, eyawaayo emyaka gye egy'enkomerero okugolokoka ku ssaawa kkumi ez'oku makya okusaba. Yafa nga tamanyiddwa nnyo ebweru w'amakanisa ge yali aweerezza, ng'aleka enfunda z'ebiwandiiko; oluvannyuma lw'ekyasa, ebitabo bye ku kusaba byavvuunulwa mu nnimi amakumi n'amakumi era tebibuzanga ku katale. Ye omu ku bulambulukufu obusinga obw'obulamu obwabala ebibala byabwo kumpi byonna nga buwedde.

q: Obulamu bwe obw'omu buto bwali butya?
a: Yazaalibwa mu Missouri mu 1835 era n'atuumibwa erinnya ly'omulabirizi w'oku nsalo William McKendree. Kitaawe yafa ng'alina emyaka kkumi n'ena, era, ng'abavubuka bangi ab'omulembe gwe, yagenda ebugwanjuba mu myaka egy'okunoonya zaabu, n'oluvannyuma n'akomawo okusoma amateeka, n'akkirizibwa mu bannamateeka ng'omu ku bannamateeka abasinga obuvubuka mu ssaza. Yakyusibwa mu kuzuukuka kw'Abamesodisiti, n'aleka omulimu gw'amateeka — ekintu ekigwana okwetegerezebwa ku musajja eyatendekebwa okuwakanya — era mu 1859, ng'alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu ena, n'ayawulibwa.

Mu 1861 yakwatibwa abaserikale b'Obumu ng'ateeberezebwa okuwagira Obukiikaddyo, n'asabibwa okulayira obwesigwa oba okusasula engassi; yagaana byombi, si olwa byabufuzi wabula kubanga teyandikakiddwa mu nsonga ya mwoyo, era n'akuumirwa mu kkomera okumala emyezi nga kkumi na munaana. Oluvannyuma yaweereza olutalo olusigadde ng'omusumba w'abaserikale ba Confederate era n'akubibwa ekitala e Franklin. Ensonga gye yaweereza yalwanirira okukuuma obuddu, era tewali kye yawandiika oluvannyuma ekikyusa ekyo.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo e Franklin oluvannyuma lw'olutalo?
a: Yaddayo e Franklin — ekibuga mwe yali afumitiddwa, ennimiro zaakyo nga zikyalimu abasajja be yali aziise — okusumba ekkanisa ya Mesodisiti eyo, era enkola ye yali nnyangu nnyo ku ngeri esekesa. Yanoonya abasajja abatono abaakkiriza ddala nti okusaba kukola ekintu, n'asanga nga mukaaga, era buli kiro ky'Olwokusatu ne bafukamira awamu ne basaba ku lwabwe bennyini, ku lw'ekkanisa, ku lw'ekibuga, ne ku lw'okuzuukuka mu ggwanga eryamenyeka era eryali likaawe.

Ekyasa ekyo kye kyakola ebimusigaddeko byonna. Buli kye yawandiika oluvannyuma ku butaba na mugaso bw'ebyuma n'obwetaavu bw'abasajja abasaba, yakisookera ku lubalaza lw'ekkanisa mu kibuga ekyawangulwa: "Ekkanisa ky'eyetaaga leero si byuma bingi oba ebisingako obulungi, si bibiina bipya oba enkola empya era eziwerako, wabula abasajja Omwoyo Omutukuvu b'ayinza okukozesa — abasajja ab'okusaba, abasajja ab'amaanyi mu kusaba."

Mu ngeri eya bulijjo, yee. Yasumba mu Alabama ne Missouri era n'aweereza ng'omutereezi wa St Louis Christian Advocate, n'oluvannyuma ng'omutereezi omuyambi owa Nashville Christian Advocate, okumala ekiseera emu ku mmeeza ezisinga okukwatibwako mu Bumesodisiti obw'Obukiikaddyo. Yawasa emirundi ebiri — mukyala we owoolubereberye, Emmie, yafa mu 1886 — era yalina abaana mwenda bonna awamu. Omusajja eyawandiika n'okunyiigiriza ku kusaba ku ssaawa kkumi ez'oku makya teyali mumonaki alina ennyumba enkalu, wabula kitaawe w'ennyumba ejjudde.

q: Essaawa ez'emisana nga tegunnakya zaali zitya?
a: Nga mu 1894 yaleka entebe y'omutereezi n'agenda e Washington, mu Georgia, n'atakwata nate kituuti kikulu, era n'afuula okusaba omulimu gwe omukulu — mu makulu gaakyo amangu ag'omulimu. Yagolokokanga ku ssaawa kkumi ez'oku makya n'asaba okutuuka ku ssaawa emu, era abaamumanya baannyonnyola omusajja atambula era ng'asaba n'eddoboozi ery'waggulu mu ssaawa ez'ekizikiza, emirundi mingi ng'akutte ekyawandiikibwa kimu okumala ennaku okutuusa lwe kyaka. Kumpi tewaali n'omu amutunuulira.

Ebiwandiiko munaana ku kusaba, nga bikwata ku bwetaavu bwakwo, ku busobozi bwakwo, ku bwannamaddala bwakwo, ku byokulwanyisa byakwo, ne ku basajja abaasaba mu Byawandiikibwa. Kimu kyokka, "Omubuulizi n'Okusaba" (1907, oluvannyuma ne kituumibwa "Amaanyi Okuyita mu Kusaba"), kye kyafuna afulumya ng'akyali mulamu; ebirala omusanvu byasigala nga biwandiiko bwawandiiko, era teyalina nsonga yonna ey'okukkiriza nti byandisomeddwa. "Abasajja abaakolera Katonda ebisinga obungi mu nsi eno baabanga ku maviivi gaabwe bukyali," bwe yawandiika.

Bounds yafiira awaka mu Washington, mu Georgia, nga 24 Agusito 1913, ng'amaze okuwandiikira mukwano gwe nti: "Bw'aba yeeteeseteese, nange mba neeteeseteese; nneegomba okulega ku ssanyu ery'omu ggulu." Ebiwandiiko byandikomye mu kasenge aka waggulu; mu kifo ky'ekyo emikwano ebiri, Claudius Chilton ne Homer Hodge, ne batwala omulimu ogw'okubitereeza n'okubifunira abafulumya, era ne bifuluma okuyita mu myaka gya 1920 okutuuka mu 1931. Teyalaba na kimu ku ebyo, naye okuva olwo bisomeddwa mu nnimi amakumi n'amakumi abantu abasinga obungi ku abo abaamuwulira ng'abuulira.

Bounds si muyivu wa by'obwakatonda atereezeddwa era teyeefuula kuba bw'atyo; yeeddiŋŋana era akomerera omusumaali gumu. Naye yawandiika ng'omusajja annyonnyola ekintu kye yakolanga buli nkya so si ekyo kye yali asomye ku kyo, era ekyo kye kiviirako ebitabo bye okuwangaala kumpi buli kintu ekyafulumizibwa awamu nabyo. Enzikiriza ye ey'omusingi tekyuka: Katonda akolera mu bantu, so si mu nteekateeka. "Okwogera n'abantu ku lwa Katonda kintu kikulu," bwe yawandiika, "naye okwogera ne Katonda ku lw'abantu kisinga obukulu."
